acceptance_rule: Require aggregate expected_value_score > 13.4968 (>10% above 12.2698), aggregate PnL above 237852.27, no canonical-window EV or PnL regression, max-drawdown drift <=1 percentage point, unchanged trade/survival counts except deterministic cash clipping, positive and negative N-PORT buckets in every window, and shared default-off daily/replay parity with zero live-order impact.

hub_identity.reservation_rule: Reserve the ticket (atomic O_EXCL create) before writing runners, artifacts, data, or logs. Existing IDs are rejected across registry, JSONL, tickets, logs, artifacts, data, and runners.

hypothesis: Risk-allocation alpha from the new SEC Form N-PORT public as-filed registered-fund holdings source: for an executed core company position with at least 20 continuously reporting fund series, split-adjusted aggregate shares increasing quarter over quarter should merit a fixed 1.10 opening-notional scalar, decreasing shares a 0.90 scalar, and missing coverage 1.00, improving expected-value score and PnL while all non-sizing behavior and live orders stay unchanged.
locked_variables: filing date strictly before entry date

in_flight_duplicate_guard.rule: AGENTS.md §7 并发重复 reserve: the novelty gate cannot see in-flight tickets, so reservation re-checks open proposed/claimed/running tickets from the last 7 days and blocks fingerprint near-duplicates (score >= 0.65). nearest.reopen_condition: Do not use SEC text archive missingness as an allocation signal. If this edge is revisited, replace it with a stable production-visible field such as form type, accession-matched text_event_type, or an explicit disclosure-quality bucket and rerun Gate 1-4.
A shared production/replay default-off adapter for the alpha_score market-regime source, parity tests, and forward replacement-value rows. No live/default orders before that adapter exists.

prediction.confidence_reason: Coverage is broad (50/62 positions; minimum 219 matched series) but similar institutional-ownership mechanisms have often failed and late/mid positive buckets are sparse.

calibration.surprise_note: All three windows regressed; negative-flow haircuts cut winners and the positive branch was cap-limited.

post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The 0.90 negative bucket cut many of the strategy's largest winners, removing 9443.76 dollars in aggregate, while existing position caps muted the positive branch: only 7 material increases occurred versus 28 material negative haircuts.
post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry the same N-PORT aggregate-share sign with different scalars, one-sided use, sample minimum, report-gap/recency, split tolerance, fund/ticker subset, or position cap on the canonical windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A genuinely different N-PORT signal with a predeclared mechanism plus an unseen out-of-sample window or materially new settled forward rows; otherwise switch data sources.

production_impact: None. quant/run.py and all live/default sizing paths remain unchanged; only a pure default-off helper and reproducibility artifacts were retained.
single_causal_variable: SEC N-PORT split-adjusted continuous-fund QoQ aggregate-share sign controls a fixed positive=1.10 negative=0.90 missing=1.00 opening-notional scalar.
